nodes.name: TeleCRM Search (Realtime)
nodes.notes: Fetches the live TeleCRM lead because the three-question scorer requires fields not stored in new-telecrm.

parameters.query: ={{ (() => { const phone = $json.phone; const write = $json.should_write_temperature === true; const clear = $json.should_clear_temperature === true; const d = $json.temperature_derived || {}; const unset = ['lead_temperature', 'temperature_calculated_at', 'temperature_outcome', 'temperature_rule']; if (clear) unset.push('temperature', 'calculated_at', 'temperature_derived'); const stages = [{ '$match': { phone } }]; if (write) { stages.push({ '$set': { temperature: $json.temperature, calculated_at: $json.calculated_at, temperature_derived: { attempts: d.attempts ?? 0, connected: d.connected ?? 0, d_captured: d.d_captured ?? null, d_inbound: d.d_inbound ?? null, d_call: d.d_call ?? null } } }); } stages.push({ '$unset': unset }); stages.push({ '$merge': { into: 'new-telecrm', on: '_id', whenMatched: 'replace', whenNotMatched: 'discard' } }); return JSON.stringify(stages); })() }}

={{ JSON.stringify([{ '$match': { '$or': [{ temperature_outcome: { '$exists': true } }, { temperature_rule: { '$exists': true } }, { 'temperature_derived.status': { '$exists': true } }, { 'temperature_derived.d_status': { '$exists': true } }, { 'temperature_derived.future_session': { '$exists': true } }] } }, { '$set': { temperature_derived: { '$cond': [{ '$eq': [{ '$type': '$temperature_derived' }, 'object'] }, { attempts: { '$ifNull': ['$temperature_derived.attempts', 0] }, connected: { '$ifNull': ['$temperature_derived.connected', 0] }, d_captured: { '$ifNull': ['$temperature_derived.d_captured', '$temperature_derived.d_status'] }, d_inbound: '$temperature_derived.d_inbound', d_call: '$temperature_derived.d_call' }, '$temperature_derived'] } } }, { '$project': { temperature_outcome: 0, temperature_rule: 0 } }, { '$merge': { into: 'new-telecrm', on: '_id', whenMatched: 'replace', whenNotMatched: 'discard' } }]) }}

={{ JSON.stringify([{ '$facet': { total: [{ '$count': 'count' }], remaining: [{ '$match': { '$or': [{ temperature_outcome: { '$exists': true } }, { temperature_rule: { '$exists': true } }, { 'temperature_derived.status': { '$exists': true } }, { 'temperature_derived.d_status': { '$exists': true } }, { 'temperature_derived.future_session': { '$exists': true } }] } }, { '$count': 'count' }] } }, { '$project': { _id: 0, total_new_telecrm_docs: { '$ifNull': [{ '$arrayElemAt': ['$total.count', 0] }, 0] }, remaining_legacy_temperature_docs: { '$ifNull': [{ '$arrayElemAt': ['$remaining.count', 0] }, 0] } } }]) }}

={{ (() => { const phone = $json.phone; const write = $json.should_write_temperature === true; const clear = $json.should_clear_temperature === true; const d = $json.temperature_derived || {}; const unset = ['lead_temperature', 'temperature_calculated_at', 'temperature_outcome', 'temperature_rule']; if (clear) unset.push('temperature', 'calculated_at', 'temperature_derived'); const stages = [{ '$match': { phone } }]; if (write) { stages.push({ '$set': { temperature: $json.temperature, calculated_at: $json.calculated_at, temperature_derived: { attempts: d.attempts ?? 0, connected: d.connected ?? 0, d_captured: d.d_captured ?? null, d_inbound: d.d_inbound ?? null, d_call: d.d_call ?? null } } }); } stages.push({ '$unset': unset }); stages.push({ '$merge': { into: 'new-telecrm', on: '_id', whenMatched: 'replace', whenNotMatched: 'discard' } }); return JSON.stringify(stages); })() }}
